items.title: US conducts defensive strikes on Iran's Qeshm Island
items.feedTitle: U.S. strikes Iranian targets in Strait of Hormuz, U.S. official tells AP
items.summary: The US military struck Iranian radar and missile systems on Qeshm Island in the Strait of Hormuz, according to US officials. The strikes were described as limited and defensive in nature, occurring as mediators pushed for peace talks between the US and Iran. Iranian state media reported explosions on the island, and the operation occurred amid broader diplomatic efforts to negotiate a settlement.

items.title: US to mediate Ukraine-Russia peace talks in Abu Dhabi
items.feedTitle: US to mediate Ukraine-Russia talks in Abu Dhabi next week, Witkoff says
items.summary: Special Envoy Steve Witkoff announced the US would mediate working-level negotiations between Ukraine and Russia scheduled for November 10-11 in Abu Dhabi. The talks represent the Trump administration's stated mission to end the war in Ukraine through direct engagement.

items.title: Supreme Court rejects Trump bid to set aside California ballots
items.feedTitle: Supreme Court denies Trump administration request to set aside Calif. ballots
items.summary: The Supreme Court quickly rejected the Trump administration's request to force California to set aside roughly 20,000 ballots from voters the DOJ claimed were likely noncitizens. The court's one-sentence order contained no explanation and no noted dissents, essentially ending the administration's effort to block the ballots before the midterm elections.

items.title: Judge dismisses charges against ex-FBI agents in Hunter Biden case
items.feedTitle: Judge dismisses case against former FBI agents in Hunter Biden laptop investigation
items.summary: A federal judge dismissed charges against former FBI officials accused of lying during the Hunter Biden laptop investigation. The judge cited 'weaponization' concerns in throwing out the case, marking a significant development in the controversy surrounding the FBI's handling of the laptop matter.

stlouis.title: Missouri AG addresses St. Louis police chief contract dispute
stlouis.feedTitle: Missouri AG says she heard of push to keep St. Louis police chief weeks before emergency vote, and his contract could get a redo
stlouis.summary: Missouri Attorney General says she learned weeks in advance of a push to keep St. Louis police chief in office before an emergency board vote, indicating potential coordination. The controversy surrounds whether the police commissioner's contract could face a redo following the contentious vote.

stlouis.title: St. Louis receives federal grant to fight crime
stlouis.feedTitle: St. Louis, 3 other cities get share of $300 million federal grant to better fight crime
stlouis.summary: St. Louis and three other cities received a share of $300 million in federal grants aimed at enhancing public safety efforts. The funding represents a significant investment in crime-fighting infrastructure for the region.

stlouis.title: Multiple Halloween weekend shootings across St. Louis region
stlouis.feedTitle: Police investigating several Halloween weekend shootings across St. Louis region
stlouis.summary: Police investigated several shootings across the St. Louis region over the Halloween weekend. The incidents underscored ongoing public safety challenges in the metropolitan area.

items.title: Russian bombing kills 26 at Ukraine aid center in southern region
items.feedTitle: Russian bombing kills 26 people at Ukraine aid centre, Kyiv says
items.summary: At least 26 people were killed when Russian forces bombed an aid distribution center and neighboring shelter in southern Ukraine, Ukrainian officials said. President Zelenskyy condemned the attack as 'utterly horrific,' saying officials dropped nine 3,000kg aerial bombs on the village in what appeared to be a deliberate targeting of humanitarian infrastructure.

items.title: US and Russia to resume Ukraine peace talks in Abu Dhabi
items.feedTitle: U.S., Russia and Ukraine to resume peace talks in Abu Dhabi next week, Witkoff says
items.summary: The US said it would mediate trilateral working-level negotiations between Ukraine, Russia, and the United States in Abu Dhabi next week, according to Trump's special envoy. The talks represent a renewal of diplomatic efforts to end the ongoing war in Ukraine.

items.title: AI-powered malware highly likely to hit UK infrastructure by 2028
items.feedTitle: AI-powered malware ‘highly likely’ to be used to hack UK infrastructure by 2028
items.summary: The UK's National Cyber Security Centre warned that AI-powered malicious software is 'highly likely' to be used in attacks against critical facilities such as power stations, airports, and hospitals by 2028. The assessment reflects growing concerns about the evolving threat landscape as adversaries adopt AI tools.

items.title: UK government softens immigration hardline on care workers
items.feedTitle: Shabana Mahmood softens immigration plans in face of cabinet backlash
items.summary: British Home Secretary Shabana Mahmood backed down from her most hardline immigration plans, exempting care workers from a proposed 15-year wait for settlement. The exception, won after cabinet backlash, will allow an estimated 280,000 care workers and their dependents to apply for indefinite leave to remain after five years.

items.title: Cyclone Murasu makes landfall along India's Andhra coast
items.feedTitle: Cyclone Murasu makes landfall along India's coast
items.summary: Cyclone Murasu made landfall near Ongole on India's southeastern coast with wind speeds of 100-110 kmph, gusting to 120 kmph. The India Meteorological Department warned of continuing severe weather conditions, with red and orange alerts issued for multiple districts in Andhra Pradesh.

items.title: Delhi chokes as air quality reaches 'very poor' levels
items.feedTitle: Parts of Delhi reel under ‘severe’ level air pollution
items.summary: Parts of Delhi recorded 'severe' air pollution on November 3, 2026, with the 24-hour average Air Quality Index (AQI) reaching 330 (very poor) as per Central Pollution Control Board data. GRAP-2 curbs were imposed to combat the deteriorating air quality as the pollution season worsened.

items.title: Karnataka government backtracks on milk price increase
items.feedTitle: Amid public backlash, Karnataka Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar directs Karnataka Milk Federation to reduce curd prices
items.summary: Faced with public backlash and criticism from hotel owners, Karnataka Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar directed the Karnataka Milk Federation to reduce curd prices that had recently been increased. State officials said the revised prices would be released soon following recalculation.

items.title: Indian Navy rescues 20 crew from pirated vessel Azini
items.feedTitle: Indian Navy Rescues 20 Crew Members From Pirated Vessel Azini In 48-Hour Op
items.summary: The Indian Navy completed a 48-hour operation off Somalia's coast to rescue 20 crew members from the pirated vessel Azini. The operation deployed what the Navy described as 'calibrated non-kinetic measures' to counter Somali pirates threatening the commercial vessel.

items.title: Thousands displaced as homes bulldozed in Assam state
items.feedTitle: Thousands displaced as homes are bulldozed in India’s Assam state
items.summary: Hundreds of homes have been bulldozed in the Dhubri district of Assam state in northeastern India, displacing thousands of residents. The demolitions, part of government land-clearing efforts, have raised concerns about due process and housing rights for affected communities.

immigration.title: US visa revocations cross 300,000; H-1B approvals hit 97%
immigration.feedTitle: US visa revocations cross 300,000; H-1B approvals hit 97%
immigration.summary: The Trump administration has revoked over 300,000 visas as part of a broad immigration vetting crackdown, while H-1B visa approvals have reached 97% according to latest data. The mass revocation represents a significant enforcement action, though the status of individual cases and grounds for revocation remain varied.

immigration.title: New executive order ties H-1B and green card sponsorship to layoff history
immigration.feedTitle: New Executive Order and PERM Suspensions Tie H-1B and Green Card Sponsorship to Layoff History: What Employers Should Know
immigration.summary: The Trump administration proposed a new executive order linking H-1B visa and green card sponsorship eligibility to employer layoff history, and simultaneously suspended PERM labor certifications. Proposed, not yet finalized—employers should monitor the November 10 deadline for regulatory updates and potential final rules.

immigration.title: USCIS ends automatic work permit extensions effective immediately
immigration.feedTitle: Confirmed by USCIS: Automatic Extension of Work Permits by Up to 540 Days Ends, and What Renewing Workers Need to Do
immigration.summary: USCIS finalized and is now enforcing a rule ending the practice of automatically extending employment authorization documents (EADs) for workers who have timely filed renewal applications. Finalized and in effect—workers with expiring EADs can no longer count on automatic 540-day extensions and must reapply or risk gap in work authorization.

items.title: Sensex surges 1,233 points as Reliance leads rally to 7-week high
items.feedTitle: Sensex surges over 1,200 points, Nifty reclaims 23,400 as RIL leads rally
items.summary: The Sensex rallied strongly, gaining over 1,233 points and reaching a more than 7-week high, driven by a sharp rally in Reliance Industries. Markets extended gains for a third consecutive session on the back of softer oil prices, steady earnings upgrades, and positive global cues.

items.title: Disney eyes thousands of layoffs; managers asked to cut 20%
items.feedTitle: Disney Eyes Thousands of Layoffs, With Managers Asked to Cut 20%
items.summary: Disney announced plans for significant workforce reductions across the company, with managers directed to identify 20% cost savings in their divisions. The layoffs represent part of broader restructuring efforts as the entertainment giant seeks to improve operational efficiency.

items.title: Marvell-Lumentum megadeal creates $115B 'AI connectivity leader
items.feedTitle: Marvell, Lumentum tout historic $115B deal to create ‘category leader’ in AI connectivity
items.summary: Marvell Technology and Lumentum announced a historic $115 billion merger to create a combined entity positioned as a category leader in AI connectivity solutions. The deal reflects consolidation in the semiconductor industry driven by massive demand for AI infrastructure and data center components.

items.title: Palantir reports 96% revenue growth; raises FY2026 guidance
items.feedTitle: Palantir Reports Q3 2026 U.S. Comm Revenue Growth of 148% Y/Y and Revenue Growth of 96% Y/Y; Raises FY 2026 Revenue Guidance to 91% Y/Y Growth and U.S. Comm Revenue Guidance to 143% Y/Y, Crushing Consensus Expectations
items.summary: Palantir delivered strong Q3 2026 results, reporting 96% year-over-year revenue growth and raising full-year 2026 revenue guidance to 91% YoY growth. US Commercial segment revenue surged 148% YoY, crushing consensus expectations and demonstrating accelerating demand for the data analytics platform.

cards.title: Sleep deprivation and decision-making
cards.insight: Chronic sleep loss impairs the brain's ability to regulate emotions and make sound judgments, particularly under stress. When fatigued, we're more prone to reactive rather than deliberate choices, amplifying both professional mistakes and interpersonal conflict.
cards.takeaway: Prioritize 7-9 hours of consistent sleep; treat it as non-negotiable as any business meeting, not a luxury.

cards.title: Stress-driven inflammation and immune function
cards.insight: Psychological stress triggers sustained inflammatory responses in the body, weakening immune defenses and slowing recovery from illness or injury. Chronic stress essentially ages your immune system, making you more vulnerable to infections and slower to heal.
cards.takeaway: Practice regular stress-relief (10-20 min daily): deep breathing, meditation, walks, or movement that feels genuine to you.

cards.title: Social connection and longevity
cards.insight: Quality relationships and social engagement are as protective for long-term health as exercise and nutrition. Isolation increases risk of premature mortality at rates comparable to smoking, making community and belonging cornerstone health behaviors.
cards.takeaway: Invest in one meaningful connection weekly—a call, meal, or activity with someone whose presence genuinely matters to you.

cards.title: Movement breaks and metabolic health
cards.insight: Prolonged sitting—even for those who exercise regularly—impairs glucose metabolism and cardiovascular function independent of workout duration. Brief movement interruptions (2-3 min every 30 min) significantly reduce blood sugar spikes and inflammation.
cards.takeaway: Stand, stretch, or walk for 2-3 minutes every half hour; this small habit compounds into measurable metabolic improvement.

ai.title: Anthropic reveals $17B Q3 revenue ahead of IPO launch
ai.feedTitle: Anthropic Revenue Nears $17 Billion as IPO Looms
ai.summary: Anthropic released updated financial figures ahead of its anticipated IPO, showing Q3 2026 revenue nearing $17 billion from purchase commitments. However, revenue growth has slowed sharply to 47% year-over-year, with compute costs and operating losses rising as the company scales operations and infrastructure.

ai.title: OpenAI hires former US Army Secretary Dan Driscoll
ai.feedTitle: OpenAI Hires Dan Driscoll, Former Trump Appointee at Pentagon
ai.summary: OpenAI appointed Dan Driscoll, former US Army Secretary, to the newly created role of Senior Counselor for National Security Modernization. The hire signals OpenAI's deepening engagement with US military and defense establishment as the company expands its government and policy presence.

ai.title: Anthropic warns it is approaching RSI capability for self-building AI
ai.feedTitle: Anthropic warns that it’s very close to RSI capability, aka self-building AI
ai.summary: Anthropic cautioned in its IPO filing that it is nearing Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI) capability, a technical milestone where AI systems can dramatically accelerate their own training and capability improvements. The company characterized this as a potential inflection point with significant implications for AI development and safety.

ai.title: 42AI launches behavioral world model; secures $62.5M seed funding
ai.feedTitle: 42AI comes out of stealth with $62.5M and a world model that can ‘predict human behavior’
ai.summary: 42AI emerged from stealth with $62.5 million in seed funding to develop a behavioral world model designed to predict human decisions in novel situations. Sequoia Capital led the round, valuing the startup at $300 million as it positions itself in the growing market for AI agents and decision forecasting.

ai.title: Trajectory raises $45M to democratize AI model training for non-experts
ai.feedTitle: Trajectory raises $45M to make AI model training accessible to nontechnical experts
ai.summary: Trajectory, a one-year-old startup, raised $45 million in Series A funding at a $300 million valuation to make AI model training accessible to nontechnical experts. The company's approach aims to lower barriers to AI development beyond specialized researchers and engineers.
